
{{alias}}( [μ, λ] )
    Returns a Wald (inverse Gaussian) distribution object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    μ: number (optional)
        Mean parameter. Must be greater than `0`. Default: `1.0`.

    λ: number (optional)
        Shape parameter. Must be greater than `0`. Default: `1.0`.

    Returns
    -------
    wald: Object
        Distribution instance.

    wald.mu: number
        Mean parameter. If set, the value must be greater than `0`.

    wald.lambda: number
        Shape parameter. If set, the value must be greater than `0`.

    wald.kurtosis: number
        Read-only property which returns the excess kurtosis.

    wald.mean: number
        Read-only property which returns the expected value.

    wald.mode: number
        Read-only property which returns the mode.

    wald.skewness: number
        Read-only property which returns the skewness.

    wald.stdev: number
        Read-only property which returns the standard deviation.

    wald.variance: number
        Read-only property which returns the variance.

    wald.cdf: Function
        Evaluates the cumulative distribution function (CDF).

    wald.logcdf: Function
        Evaluates the natural logarithm of the cumulative distribution function
        (CDF).

    wald.logpdf: Function
        Evaluates the natural logarithm of the probability density function
        (PDF).

    wald.mgf: Function
        Evaluates the moment-generating function (MGF).

    wald.pdf: Function
        Evaluates the probability density function (PDF).

    wald.quantile: Function
        Evaluates the quantile function at probability `p`.

    Examples
    --------
    > var wald = {{alias}}( 2.0, 3.0 );
    > wald.mu
    2.0
    > wald.lambda
    3.0
    > wald.kurtosis
    10.0
    > wald.mean
    2.0
    > wald.mode
    ~0.828
    > wald.skewness
    ~2.449
    > wald.stdev
    ~1.633
    > wald.variance
    ~2.667
    > wald.cdf( 0.8 )
    ~0.19
    > wald.logcdf( 0.8 )
    ~-1.661
    > wald.logpdf( 2.0 )
    ~-1.409
    > wald.mgf( 0.2 )
    ~1.609
    > wald.pdf( 2.0 )
    ~0.244
    > wald.quantile( 0.9 )
    ~3.985
